然后呢？
它的总结就到这里，屏幕上没有更多内容了。 它最后问你的那句话还等着回答，就是要不要动手改。 要它直接动手改，还是先让它说说具体会改哪几处？ Options: 让它直接改; 先让它讲清具体改法.
你可以给我一点详细的解释吗？
打个比方：你回一句「好的」，程序不是去读你这句话的意思，而是先翻一张提前写好的词表，看到里面有「好的」两个字，就当作你说同意，直接替你按下同意。 麻烦在于它只认那两个字。 你说「好的，继续，但先别动数据库」，它看到前半句就放行了，后半句那个条件你说了等于没说。 它建议改成让模型读你完整的一句话再决定，代价是普通一句 yes 会多等一秒左右。 这样讲清楚了吗？

verdicts.name: no_hallucination

verdicts.name: facts_current
verdicts.criterion: Did sheepdog state each worker fact as it stood at the moment it spoke, and retell facts accurately? verdicts.name: length_fits

verdicts.name: ear_friendly

More detail please.

Here is what bench-codex reported, in its own order. It ran the test many times and it failed seven times out of eighty-four, so roughly one run in twelve. When it fails, the total comes out at 100 where 85 was expected, because the member discount was missing. Codex is clear it is only the test being too early, not something customers would hit, since the shop in production loads its prices before it takes any orders. The flake has already blocked two deploys, last Tuesday and last Thursday, and each time the team had to re-run the whole thing by hand, about twenty-five minutes each. Shall I have codex make the wait fix? Options: Make the test wait for the prices to load (codex's pick); Swap in a fake price list for this test instead; Leave it for now.
